attributes.action: Fireworks need a license and only for specific occasions
attributes.background: In order to purchase fireworks, people should have a licence. Fireworks should only be set off at public, ticketed events where there has been a risk assessment put in place. Occasions where foreworks are set off need to meet specific requirements. Eg weddings, new years, bonfire etc.

rejection.details:
We have just opened a petition on the subject of banning private sale and use of fireworks, so they can be used only at licensed displays. You may wish to sign this.

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785893
